context_requirements: Expression of HSD11B1 or HSD11B2 in the assayed cell line
Availability of endogenous glucocorticoid substrate for the enzyme
Glucocorticoid receptor signaling active enough to be modulated
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
A shared transcriptional signature across multiple cell lines after treatment
Changes in known glucocorticoid-responsive landmark genes such as TSC22D3, DUSP1, or NFKBIA
